Week 19, September 8, 2026 in St. Petersburg

Week 19-- Home is Where the WiFi Connects Automatically

Shout out to Sister Olsen for two amazing member meals and this quote!

Sorry about the missed email last week! This area is soooo busy and there's so much phone work and I don't have a very strong desire to be on my phone more than I have to. I'll probably start writing shorter emails now, but first here's some highlights from last week!

Saturday, 08/29-- Saturday was my four month mark! It was also Sister Robison's month mark, but she's much older than me-- she turned 11.

Sunday, 08/30-- No one came to church :(

Monday, 08/31-- Our phone has been finicky for the last 1-2 weeks, so we didn't get text messages from its least favorite people for most of the transfer up to this point. Monday evening, ALL 138 of them came through. You can guess what we spent our prime time doing... 🙃 🫠

Tuesday, 09/01-- We were on our phones all day. And by all day, I mean ALL DAY. We still had over 100 texts to respond to. On the plus side, we got to go with the Elders to give one of our members who is staying at a hospital in Clearwater a blessing!

Wednesday, 09/02-- We went out to John's Pass down in Treasure Island as a district! It's this cute shopping center right across from the water. Then we went to play pickleball at the church. During prime time we put someone on date for baptism and made a friend! Overall a very good p-day :)

Now about this week! We have a mission tour (a couple church leaders are coming to the mission and talking to us) tomorrow, so that's why p-day is Tuesday this week!

Friday, 09/04-- We had an amazing lesson with our friend Maja (Maya) on Friday! She wants to feel more peace through Jesus Christ

Saturday, 09/05-- Brad Wilcox gave a devotion to the mission again!! This time he came to Tampa, so I got to see him in person! His message was so amazing and I learned so much from him!

Sunday, 09/06-- Dimitri came to church!! He's a referral that we made a friend after the service. He really liked it and wants to learn more!!

Monday, 09/07-- We keep seeing our homeless (??-- we met him at his house 🤔) friend Roger on the side of the road.

Tuesday, 09/08-- Sister Robison woke me up in a panic at 2am because she thought it was 2 in the afternoon 😂

Spiritual thought-- Isaiah 6:8 Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

Bishop shared this verse with us this week and it is so powerful! May we be the ones that the Lord can trust to fulfill His commands, and may we have the faith to trust Him back.

Let other pens dwell on guilt and misery, Sister Christison
